title: Deficient elements
description: New blocks and items that are so lacking in the game.
body:
Deficient elements is a mod that adds a variety of chips that would look good in the game. The players have been asking for these chips for a long time, so I decided to add them...
The mod was created on NeoForge for version 1.21.8.

A variety of functions have been added to this mod. Basically, variations of existing blocks, such as:
- Netherak
- End stone 
- Ore Blocks
- Wool
- Terracotta
- Concrete
- And many more things!!!

This mod offers you blocks, thanks to which your buildings can become better and more beautiful.
